verdict.rationale: Docs confirm companies can have multiple work locations with different pay schedules (gusto-docs-31) and multi-location management is a platform capability (gusto-docs-45), implying support for varied schedules across teams/locations, but there's no explicit documentation of configuring named schedules like weekly/biweekly/semimonthly/monthly or assigning distinct schedules per team via the API. missing for 10: explicit API/endpoint documentation for creating or selecting pay frequency types (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly), evidence of per-team (vs per-location) schedule assignment, and any hands-on/independent confirmation of multi-schedule setup working in practice.
